attributes.description: Overview of User inventory report from Workday in Elastic.

params.markdown:
#### Workday

**User**

This dashboard gives visibility into the Workday user inventory data stream for Entity Analytics. It highlights total inventory records and unique users, trends of user records over time, and workforce breakdowns by worker type, status, job title, and manager flag. It surfaces top users, organization roles, and security groups. Use the controls above to filter by user name, worker status, worker type, and location. Together, these panels offer an identity-inventory view to support security oversight, auditing, and workforce analysis.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/workday/overview)**
